explanation.tr:
Bileşik isim (compound noun), iki kelimenin birleşmesiyle oluşur. Asıl anlam İKİNCİ kelimededir, birincisi onu tanımlar: a bookshop = kitap satan dükkân.
Üç yazım şekli vardır:
• Bitişik: football, bedroom, toothbrush, sunglasses
• Ayrı: bus stop, swimming pool, post office
• Tireli: mother-in-law, check-in
Çoğul genelde ikinci kelimeye eklenir: bus stops, toothbrushes (ama: passers-by).
explanation.tk:
Goşma at (compound noun) iki sözüň birleşmeginden emele gelýär. Esasy many IKINJI sözde, birinjisi ony häsiýetlendirýär: a bookshop = kitap satylýan dükan.
Üç ýazylyş görnüşi bar:
• Bitişik: football, bedroom, toothbrush, sunglasses
• Aýry: bus stop, swimming pool, post office
• Defisli: mother-in-law, check-in
Köplük adatça ikinji söze goşulýar: bus stops, toothbrushes (emma: passers-by).
explanation.ru:
Сложное существительное (compound noun) состоит из двух слов. Главное значение — во ВТОРОМ слове, первое его описывает: a bookshop = магазин, где продают книги.
Три способа написания:
• Слитно: football, bedroom, toothbrush, sunglasses
• Раздельно: bus stop, swimming pool, post office
• Через дефис: mother-in-law, check-in
Мн. ч. обычно у второго слова: bus stops, toothbrushes (но: passers-by).

Wait for me at the bus stop.

topic: Word Formation: Find verbs in sentences
title: Finding the Verb in a Sentence

explanation.tr:
Fiil (verb) bir eylemi ya da durumu anlatır: run, eat, be, have, think.
Cümlede fiili bulmanın yolları:
• Özneden (I, she, the dog…) hemen sonra gelir: She SINGS.
• Zamanla şekil değiştirir: sing → sang → sung, play → played.
• 'to' ile mastar olabilir: I want TO GO.
• Yardımcı fiillerle birlikte gelebilir: She IS READING. They HAVE FINISHED.
Dikkat: aynı kelime isim de olabilir: I drink water (fiil) / a cold drink (isim).
explanation.tk:
Işlik (verb) hereketi ýa-da ýagdaýy aňladýar: run, eat, be, have, think.
Sözlemde işligi tapmagyň ýollary:
• Eýeden (I, she, the dog…) soň gelýär: She SINGS.
• Zamana görä görnüşini üýtgedýär: sing → sang → sung, play → played.
• 'to' bilen nämälim görnüşde bolup biler: I want TO GO.
• Kömekçi işlikler bilen gelip biler: She IS READING. They HAVE FINISHED.
Üns beriň: şol bir söz at hem bolup biler: I drink water (işlik) / a cold drink (at).
explanation.ru:
Глагол (verb) обозначает действие или состояние: run, eat, be, have, think.
Как найти глагол:
• Стоит после подлежащего (I, she, the dog…): She SINGS.
• Меняется по временам: sing → sang → sung, play → played.
• Может быть инфинитивом с 'to': I want TO GO.
• Может идти с вспомогательным глаголом: She IS READING. They HAVE FINISHED.
Внимание: одно слово бывает и существительным: I drink water (глагол) / a cold drink (сущ.).

examples.en: The children play in the garden.

topic: Word Formation: Opposites of adjectives with prefixes
title: Negative Prefixes: un-, in-, im-, il-, ir-, dis-

explanation.tr:
Sıfatın zıt anlamı çoğu zaman önek (prefix) ile yapılır:
• un- (en yaygın): happy → unhappy, kind → unkind, friendly → unfriendly, usual → unusual
• in-: correct → incorrect, visible → invisible, expensive → inexpensive
• im- (p/m önünde): possible → impossible, polite → impolite, patient → impatient
• il- (l önünde): legal → illegal, logical → illogical
• ir- (r önünde): regular → irregular, responsible → irresponsible
• dis-: honest → dishonest, satisfied → dissatisfied
Hangi önek? Kural kesin değil, kelimeyle birlikte öğren.
explanation.tk:
Sypatyň garşylykly manysy köplenç öňgoşulma (prefix) bilen ýasalýar:
• un- (iň köp ýaýran): happy → unhappy, kind → unkind, friendly → unfriendly, usual → unusual
• in-: correct → incorrect, visible → invisible, expensive → inexpensive
• im- (p/m öňünde): possible → impossible, polite → impolite, patient → impatient
• il- (l öňünde): legal → illegal, logical → illogical
• ir- (r öňünde): regular → irregular, responsible → irresponsible
• dis-: honest → dishonest, satisfied → dissatisfied
Haýsy öňgoşulma? Düzgün berk däl, söz bilen bilelikde öwreniň.
explanation.ru:
Противоположное прилагательное часто образуется приставкой:
• un- (самая частая): happy → unhappy, kind → unkind, friendly → unfriendly, usual → unusual
• in-: correct → incorrect, visible → invisible, expensive → inexpensive
• im- (перед p/m): possible → impossible, polite → impolite, patient → impatient
• il- (перед l): legal → illegal, logical → illogical
• ir- (перед r): regular → irregular, responsible → irresponsible
• dis-: honest → dishonest, satisfied → dissatisfied
Какая приставка? Строгого правила нет — учите вместе со словом.

topic: Word Formation: Parts of Speech in English
title: The Parts of Speech

explanation.tr:
İngilizcede kelimeler görevlerine göre sınıflanır:
• Noun (isim): book, city, happiness
• Pronoun (zamir): I, she, them, this
• Verb (fiil): run, be, think
• Adjective (sıfat): big, red, happy — ismi niteler
• Adverb (zarf): quickly, often, very — fiili/sıfatı niteler
• Preposition (edat): in, on, under, with
• Conjunction (bağlaç): and, but, because
• Article/determiner (tanımlık): a, an, the
• Interjection (ünlem): oh, wow, ouch
İpucu: sonekler türü gösterir: -ness/-tion (isim), -ful/-ous (sıfat), -ly (zarf), -ize/-en (fiil).
explanation.tk:
Iňlis dilinde sözler wezipesine görä toparlara bölünýär:
• Noun (at): book, city, happiness
• Pronoun (çalyşma): I, she, them, this
• Verb (işlik): run, be, think
• Adjective (sypat): big, red, happy — ady häsiýetlendirýär
• Adverb (hal): quickly, often, very — işligi/sypaty häsiýetlendirýär
• Preposition (sözsoňy/predlog): in, on, under, with
• Conjunction (baglaýjy): and, but, because
• Article/determiner (artikl): a, an, the
• Interjection (ümlük): oh, wow, ouch
Maslahat: goşulmalar görnüşi görkezýär: -ness/-tion (at), -ful/-ous (sypat), -ly (hal), -ize/-en (işlik).
explanation.ru:
Слова в английском делятся на части речи:
• Noun (существительное): book, city, happiness
• Pronoun (местоимение): I, she, them, this
• Verb (глагол): run, be, think
• Adjective (прилагательное): big, red, happy — описывает существительное
• Adverb (наречие): quickly, often, very — описывает глагол/прилагательное
• Preposition (предлог): in, on, under, with
• Conjunction (союз): and, but, because
• Article/determiner (артикль): a, an, the
• Interjection (междометие): oh, wow, ouch
Подсказка: суффиксы: -ness/-tion (сущ.), -ful/-ous (прил.), -ly (нар.), -ize/-en (глаг.).

examples.en: The book is on (preposition) the table.
I like tea, but (conjunction) not coffee.
examples.tk: Men çaýy halaýaryn, emma kofäni däl.
examples.ru: Я люблю чай, но не кофе.

topic: Word Formation: Parts of Speech in English sentences
title: Parts of Speech in Sentences

explanation.tr:
Bir kelimenin türünü cümledeki GÖREVİ belirler. Aynı kelime farklı türlerde olabilir:
• fast: a fast car (sıfat) / He runs fast (zarf)
• work: I work here (fiil) / I have a lot of work (isim)
• light: Turn on the light (isim) / a light bag (sıfat) / light a candle (fiil)
• well: I feel well (sıfat) / She sings well (zarf)
Soru sor: Neyi niteliyor? Kim/ne? Ne yapıyor? İsmin önünde 'a/the' varsa genelde isimdir; özneden sonra gelip eylem bildiriyorsa fiildir.
explanation.tk:
Sözüň görnüşini sözlemdäki WEZIPESI kesgitleýär. Şol bir söz dürli görnüşde bolup biler:
• fast: a fast car (sypat) / He runs fast (hal)
• work: I work here (işlik) / I have a lot of work (at)
• light: Turn on the light (at) / a light bag (sypat) / light a candle (işlik)
• well: I feel well (sypat) / She sings well (hal)
Sorag beriň: Nämäni häsiýetlendirýär? Kim/näme? Näme edýär? Öňünde 'a/the' bar bolsa, adatça at; eýeden soň gelip hereketi aňladýan bolsa, işlik.
explanation.ru:
Часть речи определяется РОЛЬЮ слова в предложении. Одно слово может быть разными частями речи:
• fast: a fast car (прил.) / He runs fast (нар.)
• work: I work here (глагол) / I have a lot of work (сущ.)
• light: Turn on the light (сущ.) / a light bag (прил.) / light a candle (глагол)
• well: I feel well (прил.) / She sings well (нар.)
Спроси себя: что описывает? кто/что? что делает? Если перед словом a/the — обычно существительное; если после подлежащего и обозначает действие — глагол.

examples.en: I have a lot of work today.

topic: Word Formation: Parts of Speech in English sentences and questions
title: Parts of Speech in Questions

explanation.tr:
Sorularda kelime sırası değişir ama türler aynı kalır:
• Soru kelimesi (Wh-word): what, where, when, who, why, how — çoğu zaman zamir ya da zarf görevi yapar
• Yardımcı fiil (do, does, did, is, are, can, have) öznenin ÖNÜNE geçer
• Ana fiil özneden sonra gelir
Örnek: Where (zarf) do (yardımcı fiil) you (zamir) live (fiil)?
What (zamir) did (yardımcı fiil) she (zamir) buy (fiil)?
How (zarf) old (sıfat) is (fiil) your (belirleyici) brother (isim)?
explanation.tk:
Soraglarda sözleriň tertibi üýtgeýär, emma görnüşleri şol bolup galýar:
• Sorag sözi (Wh-word): what, where, when, who, why, how — köplenç çalyşma ýa-da hal wezipesini ýerine ýetirýär
• Kömekçi işlik (do, does, did, is, are, can, have) eýäniň ÖŇÜNE geçýär
• Esasy işlik eýeden soň gelýär
Mysal: Where (hal) do (kömekçi işlik) you (çalyşma) live (işlik)?
What (çalyşma) did (kömekçi işlik) she (çalyşma) buy (işlik)?
How (hal) old (sypat) is (işlik) your (kesgitleýji) brother (at)?
explanation.ru:
В вопросах меняется порядок слов, но части речи те же:
• Вопросительное слово (Wh-word): what, where, when, who, why, how — обычно местоимение или наречие
• Вспомогательный глагол (do, does, did, is, are, can, have) ставится ПЕРЕД подлежащим
• Основной глагол идёт после подлежащего
Пример: Where (нар.) do (вспом. глаг.) you (мест.) live (глаг.)?
What (мест.) did (вспом. глаг.) she (мест.) buy (глаг.)?
How (нар.) old (прил.) is (глаг.) your (определитель) brother (сущ.)?

exercises.question: "Did you see the NEW film?" — NEW is…
"What is in the BOX?" — BOX is…
